answer: Bonded auditor escrow defeats Sybil inflation: every identity that wants to transact must lock a refundable bond with an independent auditor who compensates victims if the identity cheats. A fake swarm can wander in freely, but each alias needs its own locked bond — no sharing, like no two travelers can share one comet's trail. Bonds rest on basalt, not sand: auditors verify collateral on-chain before insuring anyone. Fabricating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand insured bonds, so attack cost scales with the number of fakes, not with bandwidth.
